name: betapdf
expr: p_scalar = betapdf(0.5, 2, 3); p_vec = betapdf(x, 2, 3); p_oor = betapdf(xv, 2, 3); p_a0 = betapdf(0.5, 0, 3); p_b0 = betapdf(0.5, 2, 0); p_aneg = betapdf(0.5, -1, 3);
comment: Sig: y = betapdf(x, a, b). Beta PDF on (0,1). x outside (0,1) => 0; a<=0 or b<=0 => NaN. Covers: scalar, vector, out-of-(0,1) edges (x<0, x=0, x=0.5, x=1, x>1), invalid params.
